entries.content: Added a music player with search and playlists.
Top players of the month now show on the podium.
Rebuilt the loading screen on the new studio.
Fixed the changelog arrows skipping an entry.
Background slideshow supports video and YouTube.
Improved loading times and UI responsiveness.
Fixed minor bugs in the audio player.

designs.name: DirkScripts Default
designs.description: The shipped loading screen rebuilt as editable elements — Top Players, Changelog, Music and links over a cycling background. The default the studio opens on.

designs.name: Minimal
designs.description: Logo, server name, progress and a rotating tip, centred over your backgrounds. Quiet, and quick to make your own.

designs.name: Spotlight
designs.description: One column down the left, background full-bleed. Lets your screenshots do the work — good if you have art worth showing.

designs.name: Broadcast
designs.description: A single strip along the bottom, image untouched above it. Identity left, now playing centre, links right.

designs.name: Dashboard
designs.description: Changelog, podium and music as three equal cards, everything visible at once. No tabs to open.
